_comment: The store listing, as data. `store/check-listing.ts` reads this; `store/LISTING.md` explains
the two delivery paths. Summary is package metadata. The API cannot write the editable fields,
so this file records what the package and Developer Dashboard are supposed to say, keeping drift
Summary and Description live beside this file as plain text. Summary feeds the manifest; the
Description is pasted verbatim into the console, where escaped JSON would not be practical.
name: Parle
_permissionsComment: The permission set the shipped package must declare, asserted by store/check-release.ts.
It lives here rather than in that script because it is the same list the Privacy tab writes a
justification for (LISTING.md §2.2): an undeclared extra permission blocks submission, and a
permission removed from the build but left justified is a listing that describes a different
extension. Changing what the extension asks for is therefore one edit, not two, and the
package audit fails until it is made.
